_comment: Chatterbox-Turbo paralinguistic-tag test. Each character clones from a fixed reference clip in refs/; lines embed inline tags ([gasp]/[laugh]/[sigh]/[cough]/[chuckle]) plus a per-line exaggeration (0=flat .. ~1.5=intense). Goal: hear whether Turbo renders the tags AND varies emotion while keeping each voice consistent.

lines.text: [gasp] Incoming! Everybody down — get to cover!
[sigh] Okay... okay, we're clear. Everybody still with me?
On your feet, Marines. We are not done yet. [cough] Move out!
[gasp] Whoa, whoa, whoa — are you seeing this right now?!
[laugh] Oh, that's great. We're lost in space and the Kino's out of battery.
[sigh] Okay. Deep breaths, Eli. You've totally got this. [chuckle] Probably.
Stay with me — [gasp] I need a hand over here, now!
[sigh] You're going to be okay. Just breathe. I've got you.
[sigh] I haven't slept in two days. [cough] But the patient's stable.
